## What changes

Describe the concrete behavior or documentation change and why it is needed. Link an issue if one exists.

## Evidence and limits

For game behavior, cite relevant client Lua, proto, config paths or message IDs. Mark behavior the client cannot prove as *(inferred)*. Note known gaps or runtime checks you could not perform.

## Validation

List the exact build/test commands and results. State whether you had exported game data and a client for integration checks. Do not include client files, exported data, credentials, or unsanitized logs.
